description: Rules modules that call a measuring service method (`measure_*`) without a measured-value provider of their own. `answeredBy` names the registered measured values or member lists that expose what the module measures (answered by the engine or a shared provider); `searchOnly` gives why the module only searches. A module absent here must register a `measured.rs` provider; an entry for a module that no longer measures, or now has its own provider, is stale and fails the gate.

searchOnly.accessible_route: searches a route through connectors and walkable runs; the runs' own measurements are the stair and ramp values
searchOnly.clash: proximity only narrows the candidate pairs the clash service decides
searchOnly.clash_cases: measures a found clash's overlap to describe it, never to decide it
searchOnly.comparison: distances only pair an object with its counterpart in the other revision
searchOnly.component_clearance: searches the free zone in front of a component for obstructions
searchOnly.component_visibility: searches sight lines from a component's centre
searchOnly.containment: face distances decide which container an object lies in
searchOnly.external_wall_validation: envelope membership classifies walls by the envelope search
